info.cls_ename: Honor Program of Information and Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程的目標在於讓學生廣泛地認識電腦科學相關的主題，概述計算機中軟體與硬體相關的基本知識。課程主要為電腦原理的介紹，及使用計算機來解決方法論與演算法的問題。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is to make the students know the related topics of Computer Science, and to state the knowledge of software/hardware in Computer Science. The course mainly focuses on the introduction of the computer theories, and the use of computer to solve the problems of methodology and algorithm.

targets.describe_ch: 1介紹計算機相關軟硬體基本術語及觀念，使學生能以專業的詞彙做溝通
targets.describe_en: 1. To introduce the basic technology terms of computer to help students to communicate with professional engineer.

targets.describe_ch: 2 使學生瞭解計算機運作原理以及各項影響計算機效能的關鍵技術
targets.describe_en: 2. To teach students to understand computer hardware processing model and know the factors that will influence the performance of computer.

targets.describe_ch: 3使學生能瞭解程式語言的發展趨勢及相關技巧，以及發展應用程式的能力
targets.describe_en: 3. The knowledge about programming language is introduced to make students to understand the related issues about the developing for computer applications.

targets.describe_ch: 4. 以C及C++語言的介紹為主軸，介紹諸項程式設計的技術與思考習慣
targets.describe_en: 4. By introducing the C and C++ language to introduce the skills of programming.

targets.describe_ch: 5. 訓練學生程式設計的邏輯思維，建立日後專業程式撰寫的基礎
targets.describe_en: 5. Training the capability of logic reasoning and building the basics for professional programming.

targets.describe_ch: 6. 增進學生以專業的知識思維以解決問題，奠定優良的工程師專業素養
targets.describe_en: 6. To improve students' ability for professional thinking and to establish good features to be a good engineer.

readings.tpc_book: Course materials developed by Prof. Chua-Huang Huang, Department of Computer and Information Science, Feng Chia University

iSoftwares.soft_name: Dev-C++ 5.0 (4.9.9.2) with Mingw/GCC 3.4.2 compiler and GDB 5.2.1 debugger
iSoftwares.soft_memo:
Open Source C/C++ IDE for Windows
Dev-C++ is a full-featured C and C++ Integrated Development Environment (IDE) for Windows platforms. Millions of developers, students and researchers use Dev-C++ since the first version was released in 1998. It has been featured in dozens of C++ and scientific books and remains one of the favorite learning tool among universities & schools worldwide.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: Basic Data Structure - Arrays, Records, Linked Lists
Implementation of Links - C Pointers, Call by Reference by pointers, Examples of Using Pointers, Pointer Arithmetic, Arrays of Pointers, Pointers to Functions
More Data Structures and Abstract Data Types - Stacks, Queues, Trees, Binary Trees, Binary Search Trees, Graphs
File Structures - Access Methods, Sequential Files, Index Files, Hashed Files, Directories,
Databases -Database Management Systems, Database Architecture, Database Models, The Relational Database Model, Operations on Relations, Database Design
Software Engineering - Software Life Cycle, Software Requirement Phase, Software Design Phase, Implementation Phase, Testing Phase, Documentation
Computer Networks - OSI Model, Layer STructure, TCP/IP Suite, Internet Applications
Information Security - Cryptographiy, Key Management, Security Attacks, Prevention Methods

assignments.

solutions and your submitted solutions as well as answer the following questions.

If you did NOT reply above three questions for each problem, you may get a zero point for that solution.
For exams or on-site tests, the ChatGPT or any other networking communication is prohibited
